section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining the psychometric properties of a Brazilian Portuguese translation of the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS) in 194 Brazilian university women. The study measured body appreciation, body satisfaction, BMI (objectively measured), and attitudes toward appearance ideals, finding that breast size dissatisfaction was significantly associated with lower body appreciation and higher BMI among other variables.
